hooks.command: bash -c 'set -- project_plans/*/requirements.md; [ -e "$1" ] || exit 0; set -- project_plans/*/implementation/plan.md; if [ ! -e "$1" ]; then echo "📋 SDD: requirements.md ready — next: /sdd:2-research then /sdd:3-plan"; exit 0; fi; set -- project_plans/*/implementation/validation.md; if [ ! -e "$1" ]; then echo "📋 SDD: plan.md ready — run /sdd:4-validate before writing any code"; exit 0; fi; echo "📋 SDD: planning complete — ready for /sdd:5-implement or /sdd:full"; exit 0'
